name: cc-codex-triage
description: Talk to OpenAI Codex CLI from Claude Code with persistent conversation memory across turns. Adds /ask, /review (iterates to APPROVE, findings ledger, --continue), /plan, /reply, /debate, /status, /cleanup, /review-dispute, /review-accept, /review-defer, /autoreview, /autoplan, /thread, /thread-list, /thread-new. State hygiene built in: armed gates auto-expire (14-day TTL), state anchors to the repo root, and --detach keeps background dispatches alive through harness process-reaping.
